items.headline: LIV Golf Future Uncertain
items.text: Graeme McDowell said LIV Golf faces "headwinds" securing its future post-2026 and plans to return to the DP World Tour in 2027 after settling fines and holding productive talks.

items.headline: Koivun Leads 3M Open
items.text: Rookie Jackson Koivun shot a tournament-record 28 on the back nine with two eagles and four birdies for a third-round 61, leading the 3M Open at 20-under and set to play the final round with Emiliano Grillo.
